note: OMIM entries and literature confirm OMIM #621182 (Umair-Alfadhel Neurodevelopmental Disorder) is an autosomal recessive disorder caused by biallelic/homozygous NAV3 variants.

evidence.text: The study describes a novel homozygous NAV3 variant associated with autosomal recessive neurodevelopmental disorder, also designated as Umair-Alfadhel Neurodevelopmental Disorder (OMIM: 621182).

source.title: NAV3 Missense Variant in a Homozygous State: Strengthening Links to Neurodevelopmental Disorder
source.quote: This study reports a novel NAV3 variant in association with autosomal recessive NDD, … , also known as Umair-Alfadhel Neurodevelopmental Disorder (OMIM: 621182), as demonstrated

evidence.text: OMIM entry #611629 categorizes neurodevelopmental disorder with poor or absent speech, dysmorphic facies, and behavioral abnormalities (OMIM 621182) as autosomal recessive.
